descFull: Flowfile is a visual ETL tool and Python library combining drag-and-drop workflows with Polars dataframes. Build data pipelines visually, define flows programmatically with a Polars-like API, and export to standalone Python code. Perfect for fast, intuitive data processing from development to production.
